articles.title_en: Russian strike on Kyiv kills 21-year-old woman; U.S. gave Ukraine no advance warning, journalists report
articles.lead_en: Russian forces struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight on October 19, damaging buildings in the Desnianskyi and Dniprovskyi districts, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. Three people were injured, and a 21-year-old woman was killed.

articles.title_en: 1 Killed, 5 Injured in Ukrainian Drone Attack on St. Petersburg, Governor Says
articles.lead_en: Russian air defense units downed 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry said.
